api_access.notes: Private-app read access on all tiers, but the default daily call limit and 100-records-per-page list endpoints make a 100k-record portal with associations a multi-hour export. Search endpoint capped at 10,000 results per query.

schema_introspection.notes: Properties API returns every property with type, fieldType and enum options; associations v4 exposes labels per object pair.

relational_integrity.notes: Associations are enumerable via batch read (100 ids per call), not as a single bulk list. Engagement-to-record links available the same way.

export_throughput.notes: Async CRM Exports API exists but is CSV/XLSX only and flattens associations. API-based relational export of a mid-size portal lands in the 6–24 h band on standard rate limits.

attachment_portability.notes: Files API issues signed URLs that expire; rich text (notes, emails) is HTML.
